description: Create a broadcast DRAFT — a DM sent to many contacts at once. Creating never sends anything: add people with add_broadcast_recipients, then deliver with send_broadcast. Use an accountId from list_broadcasts. Not available on WhatsApp or LinkedIn.

isSubscribed.description: Limit the segment to subscribed contacts (keep true unless the user says otherwise)

name.description: Internal campaign name (not shown to recipients)

tags.description: Contact tags defining the default segment used by add_broadcast_recipients populate (max 25)

text.description: The DM text every recipient receives

name: create_broadcast
title: Create Broadcast
